A packing list is a short note of what to take on a camping trip, so nothing important stays at home. People keep it on their phone and change it before each trip, saying things like 'add a stove so we can cook' or 'remove the big tent, we are only two'. Families who go camping on a monthly basis usually reuse the same list and change only a few lines. Many also check the weather in the hills the night before, asking 'will it be cold up there on Saturday?' A photo of the trail map is useful too, because the phone may have no signal on the trail. A monthly trip also needs a fresh look at the list, since the seasons change.
